title: gentiana trichotoma subsp. chingii
intro: Gentiana trichotoma subsp. chingii, commonly known as Ching's gentian, is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family. It is a type of medicinal herb used in traditional Chinese medicine, valued for its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ching's gentian include anti-inflammatory, immunomodulatory, and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, boost the immune system, and protect against oxidative stress. Bioactive constituents of Ching's gentian include gentianines, gentianidine, and other iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
